tagline.en: Hailuo 2.3 — MiniMax's hosted video API for image-to-video with audio, called through WorldFoundry.
tagline.zh: Hailuo 2.3——MiniMax 的托管视频 API，支持带音频的图生视频，可在 WorldFoundry 中调用。

en: Hailuo 2.3 is MiniMax's hosted video generation service. It's an image-to-video model that also produces synchronized audio, accessed as a cloud API rather than run on your own GPUs.

In WorldFoundry, Hailuo 2.3 is available through the Studio hosted-API pipeline. Because it's a hosted service, you bring your own MiniMax API key, and the output and available model versions depend on MiniMax's service and your account access.
zh: Hailuo 2.3 是 MiniMax 提供的托管视频生成服务。它是一款图生视频模型，还能生成同步音频，以云端 API 形式访问，而非在你自己的 GPU 上运行。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Hailuo 2.3 通过 Studio 托管 API pipeline 提供。由于是托管服务，你需自备 MiniMax API key，输出与可用的模型版本取决于 MiniMax 的服务与你的账户权限。

whenToUse.en: Use Hailuo 2.3 when you want high-quality image-to-video with audio and prefer calling a hosted API over managing local weights and GPUs.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要带音频的高质量图生视频，且倾向于调用托管 API 而非自行管理本地权重与 GPU 时，可用 Hailuo 2.3。

notFor.en: It's a hosted API: you need your own MiniMax API key, and results depend on the provider's service and account access. Not for fully offline or self-hosted workflows.
notFor.zh: 它是托管 API：需自备 MiniMax API key，结果依赖服务商的服务与账户权限。不适合完全离线或自托管的工作流。

en: Called through the WorldFoundry Studio hosted-API pipeline
Bring your own MiniMax API key
zh: MiniMax 托管的 Hailuo 服务
通过 WorldFoundry Studio 托管 API pipeline 调用
